learning_question: Does the Cision newsroom feed give Swedish buy-tier memos a body-bearing latest annual and interim where ESEF + Google News left them thin?

method.covered: cision_direct rows with bodies for both an annual and an interim period
method.silent: index fully re-ingested within 7d after the Cision branch shipped, yet zero cision_direct rows

limitations: Reads committed indexes only; names re-enter coverage as the ingest loop or discovery scan revisits them. Parked leftovers are released once when their fetch surface changes (source_surface on ingest_exhaustion.json). H&M and NIBE are not on Cision; ABB, Industrivärden and Lifco feeds stopped carrying reports and are unmapped. An issuer that switches newswire goes silent.
